ai_summary: This article explains what E numbers actually are and why having one does not mean an ingredient is synthetic or unsafe. It highlights the additives with genuine evidence against them, including the Southampton Six food colourings, nitrites in processed meat, gut-disrupting emulsifiers and titanium dioxide, and gives practical tips for reading UK food labels.
